configuration.title: RA2 Mod IntelliSense
configuration.properties.exePath.descrip: Absolute path to INIValidator.exe. It's recommended to set this via the status bar icon or the 'Manage INI Validator' command.
configuration.properties.validationFolde: Absolute path to the root directory of the Mod to be validated. It's recommended to set this via the setup guide or the status bar icon.
configuration.properties.validationFiles: List of files to be validated. It's recommended to edit this interactively via the status bar icon or the 'Manage INI Validator' command.
configuration.properties.indexing.includ: Legacy list of Glob patterns for indexing. It is recommended to use 'File Categories' for better classification, but patterns here will also be indexed.
configuration.properties.indexing.fileCa: Defines file categories (e.g., Rules, Art) and their corresponding Glob patterns. These files will be indexed and identified by type in the status bar.
configuration.properties.indexing.exclud: An array of Glob patterns to exclude specific files or directories from the included files. Example: ['**/*_backup.ini'].
configuration.properties.dontAskToConfig: If true, the extension will not ask you to configure INI Validator on startup.
If true, the extension will not ask you to configure the Mod project root directory on startup.
Absolute path to the INI Dictionary file (INIDictionary.ini). If not set, rule-based IntelliSense and diagnostics will be disabled.
configuration.properties.codeLens.enable: Whether to show CodeLens above sections to display their reference counts.
configuration.properties.decorations.ove: Enable or disable the inheritance override indicator (icon next to the line number and italic key name).
configuration.properties.diagnostics.ena: Enable or disable all built-in diagnostic checks.
configuration.properties.diagnostics.sev: Customize the severity of specific diagnostic rules. Key is the error code (e.g. 'S001'), value is one of 'Error', 'Warning', 'Information', 'Hint', or 'None'.
configuration.properties.iniValidator.do: Download page URL for INIValidator. Override this if the default mirror is inaccessible in your region.
configuration.properties.diagnostics.spa: Whether to check and warn about extra spaces to the left of the equals sign (=).
Whether to check and warn about extra spaces to the right of the equals sign (=).
configuration.properties.diagnostics.lea: Whether to check and warn about extra whitespace at the beginning of a line.
configuration.properties.diagnostics.spa: The exact number of spaces that should precede a comment character (;). Set to null or leave empty to disable this check.
Whether to check and warn about missing space after the comment character (;) (e.g., ';comment' instead of '; comment').

configuration.media.enabled: Enable cursor-following object and resource inspection.
configuration.media.inlineThumbnails: Show small resource thumbnails beside visible INI headers and image references.
configuration.media.hoverEnabled: Show media previews and audition links on reference values.
configuration.media.resourceRoots: Additional asset directories, in decreasing priority after the project directory.
configuration.media.archiveOrder: Explicit MIX filename precedence. All candidates are listed; unconfigured archive order is a preview choice, not a claim about engine precedence.
configuration.media.theater: Theater suffix for building filenames and custom palettes: tem, sno, urb, ubn, lun, des.
configuration.media.semanticRules: Additional contextual reference rules. First matching rule wins; dictionary types remain unchanged.
configuration.media.autoReveal: Reveal the workbench once per window session on the first valid resource section, preserving editor focus.
configuration.media.excludedDirectories: Directory names excluded from asset discovery. Defaults skip temporary caches and tool copies; explicitly configured resource roots are still scanned.
command.browseObjects.title: Browse project objects
command.configureProject.title: Configure project entry INIs
configuration.project.entryPoints: Entry INIs relative to the mod root, grouped by category (rules/art/sound). The project context uses these roots and their includes. Empty detects standard entries; unloaded files are isolated.
configuration.project.objectColumns: INI properties displayed as columns in the project object browser (up to 12).
command.previewMap.title: Preview current map
configuration.maps.renderer: Optional CNCMaps --worker JSON backend compatible with ra2rmg-rs. executable and mixDirectory require absolute paths. Supply modDirectories, rulesFiles, artFiles and extraMixes to match your project. Runs only on request in trusted workspaces.

mix.backupCount.description: Maximum write-recovery backups per file. Older backups are cleaned on subsequent writes; the latest is always retained.
mix.backupBudget.description: Write-recovery backup budget per file, in MiB. The latest backup is retained even if it alone exceeds this budget.
mix.transferBudget.description: In-memory staging budget for one transfer, in MiB. Prevents bulk imports exhausting the extension host. Transfer in batches or adjust this value for available memory.
